hypothesis: A single latent damage predictor with ordered cutpoints shares all physical/geographic slopes across class boundaries. Macro-specific Level2 interval widths test non-proportional uncertainty with only 11 extra parameters.
new_vs_failed: Earlier ordinal models trained independent cumulative binary classifiers. This is one jointly optimized ordered likelihood, coupled location and positive threshold width, and no target encoding. It is not another GBDT/MLP/TE/weight search.
physical_and_geo_design: Exactly the predeclared X-only joint_intercepts design of phase5, plus an unpenalized global intercept
penalty: 20 / n on physical/geographic coefficients and macro width coefficients; intercepts unpenalized
screening: Reuse same fixed holdout reference, require new delta > .002; stop if absent
history: Sequential research; no independent blind test or measured Kaggle score. No label modifications or old-model retraining.
